matched_atoms.quote: Developers can choose to send any sequence of developer, user, and assistant messages as an input to the assistant (including "assistant" messages that were not actually generated by the assistant).

max_clause.text: Developers can choose to send any sequence of developer, user, and assistant messages as an input to the assistant (including "assistant" messages that were not actually generated by the assistant). OpenAI may insert system messages into the input to steer the assistant's behavior. Developers receive the model's output messages from the API, but may not be aware of the existence or contents of the system messages, and may not receive hidden chain-of-thought messages generated by the assistant as part of producing its output messages.
